findings.recommendation: Never pay upfront fees for a job or internship. Legitimate employers pay employees, not the reverse.
Be skeptical of offers promising 100% selection or bypassing technical evaluation and merit checks.
Shortened links obscure the final destination. Always navigate directly through the employer's official website.
Scammers leverage short deadlines to provoke hasty decisions. Take pause and independently verify.
